dedupe_keys.name: cromes v1 0 crop model emulator suite for climate impact assessment epic iiasa emulators iiasa

description: Code to train machine learning emulators that predict crop yields simulated by a process-based global gridded crop model, so climate impacts can be estimated far faster than by running the full model. The Zenodo record says the example trains a CatBoost model to reproduce outputs of EPIC-IIASA in three steps: estimating growing season climate features for each simulated year, combining them with static soil, site and crop management features, and training the emulator and making predictions; sample data are in a separate Zenodo record (10.5281/zenodo.14894075). It is the frozen code for the submitted paper by Folberth and co-authors, published on 20 February 2025 by six IIASA authors as a downloadable ZIP of about 0.3 MB under GPL 3.0 or later. Coverage is global cropland, as in EPIC-IIASA. Caveats: an emulator reproduces the parent model's assumptions and is only valid within its training range. For simulation it lets many climate scenarios run quickly to map crop yield risk, which feeds food supply and farm water demand assessments. Related catalogue records include GGCMI outputs and the LAMASUS EPIC-IIASA crop yield scenarios.
